Infra Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spot-gpu-pool-usw2 at 100% GPU utilization, queue length growing (pending_requests=420 -> 1,250 in last 12m). Autoscaler failing to add nodes: scale_up rejected (quotaExceeded). Triggering incident channel.
Jamal (eng-sre): I'm on it. grabbing logs from autoscaler now. can someone confirm customer-facing errors?
Priya S.: Support seeing uptick in 503s and 'rate_limited' from API gateway. Several customer tickets flagged high latency and timeouts. PRD flagged for top 10 customers.
Emily R.: Confirmed increased 5xx rate on hosted API routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Error spike started ~1768401100. CPU on the dispatch plane fine, it's GPU workers starved.
Sasha M.: autoscaler logs: ``[2026-03-15T15:20:31Z] scale attempt failed: quotaExceeded: requested 32 gpus, but quota 24``. Also seeing node provisioning timeouts from the cloud provider.
Jamal (eng-sre): docs/runbooks/gpu-autoscale suggests manual scale-up if autoscaler blocked. but quota blocks that. trying to see if we have any idle dedicated pools to divert traffic.
Ops-SRE: There's a dedicated pool in us-east-1 with spare capacity (dedicated-gpu-eu). Need routing change to use dedicated for high-priority customers.
Dylan P.: Which customers are impacted? we need to triage billing tier and SLOs before moving prod traffic.
Priya S.: Top impacted list attached in support thread: cust-A, cust-C, cust-G. cust-A has an SLA.
Jamal (eng-sre): Running quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle free-tier / low-priority requests, 2) divert premium traffic to dedicated pool, 3) request immediate quota bump from cloud. executing step 1 now.
Emily R.: Throttle rule in gateway applied: drop rate for plan=free and plan=trial by 80%. Monitoring error rate.
Infra Oncall Bot: Action log: throttling rule applied by Jamal at 1768401265.
Sasha M.: Attempted to route to dedicated pool but route policy rejected: "model variant mismatch" for some old pinned models. working on on-the-fly model fallback mapping.
Jamal (eng-sre): Quick workaround: create a compatibility route to map pinned model->closest compatible instance. running patch now: ``rctl route create --from hosted/usw2 --to dedicated/us-east-1 --map model:v1->v1-quant``
DeployBot: Deployment started: route-mapping-patch v1.2 by Jamal.
Priya S.: Noting customers on pinned models will see slight quality variance if we map to quantized variant. flagged in notes for CS to notify.
Sasha M.: Autoscaler still failing. cloud support says quota increase may take ~2 hours. provisioning errors also show transient preemption on spot nodes: many spot nodes marked unrecoverable.
Jamal (eng-sre): Manual capacity add blocked. alternative: reduce per-request GPU tokens by lowering max_tokens default for free and trial; changing default now in gateway config.
Emily R.: Gateway default max_tokens reduced from 1024 -> 512 for affected plans. This should reduce average inference time and free some capacity.
Dylan P.: Good. Also enable canary fallback: if request hits queue >200, respond with degraded mode (no streaming) to keep latency bounded.
Infra Oncall Bot: Canary fallback policy enabled at 1768401402.
Ops-SRE: After routing patch, we're routing ~30% of premium traffic to dedicated pool. CPU/gpu metrics show partial relief, queue dropped from 1,250 -> 560 in 8 minutes.
Priya S.: CS updated for cust-A and cust-C. told them we're initiating routing changes and may see slight model differences; SLA remediation discussed.
Sasha M.: Still seeing spot interruptions; logs show repeated preemptions for nodes provisioned in last 30m. Need a longer-term scheduling change for spot-only pools.
Jamal (eng-sre): Short-term mitigation checklist: 1) keep throttle in place, 2) keep dedicated routing for premium, 3) continue quota requests, 4) escalate to cloud partner support for emergency capacity, 5) open postmortem owner. I'm stepping aside to escalate quota now.
Dylan P.: Declaring incident Sev2. Postmortem owner: Sasha M. Communication lead: Priya S. On-call handoff planned at 1768404000 if still ongoing.
Emily R.: Observability note: capture kv-cache hit rates and per-token latencies for next 30m. I'll export traces and add to incident artifacts.
Priya S.: Drafting customer-facing status update now. ETA for next update in 15m.
Ops-SRE: Confirmed no data plane errors, it's capacity only — no data loss. Good to mention for customers.
Sasha M.: Logged action items in incident doc: incident-redwood-1768401234. Will run follow-up to adjust spot mix and autoscaler policies.
Infra Oncall Bot: Incident channel summary: cause=spot interruptions + quota limit, impact=increased 5xx/503 and throttling for free tier, mitigations=throttle low-priority, route premium to dedicated, reduce tokens. Next update at 1768401700.
Jamal (eng-sre): Thanks team. staying on call until quota resolved or queue stable (<100). ping if anything regresses.
Priya S.: Updating support tickets and post on status.redwood.ai. :white_check_mark:
